decision: Selected the centroid of the union of Santa Clara County FY2026 parcels 706-02-057 (situs 123 GREAT OAKS BL, the SV12 building) and 706-02-060 (situs 127 GREAT OAKS BL; SV18 at 127 and SV19 at 131) as the campus locator of Equinix's three-building Great Oaks South Data Center in San Jose.

selected_properties.70602054: not present in the FY2026 layer (the query asked for it); the City permit records still carry this APN for 123 Great Oaks Bl
selected_properties.layer: County of Santa Clara Parcels (Socrata ubcd-cewv, 'land and condo information ... as of FY 2026', rows updated 26 August 2026), GeoJSON in WGS84

computed.centroid_parcel: inside 706-02-060, about 20 m from the 706-02-057 boundary
computed.method: Union of the two parcel polygons; centroid computed in EPSG:32610 (WGS 84 / UTM 10N) and returned to WGS84; an EPSG:5070 cross-check gives the same point; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: The Energy Commission notice of determination received 7 May 2026 (SCH 2020100431) states that the Great Oaks South Data Center consists of three two-story data-center buildings, SV12, SV18 and SV19, at 123, 127 and 131 Great Oaks Boulevard in San Jose; the project applicant is Equinix LLC.

The City of San Jose permit lists place the SV12x data-hall fit-out permits at 123 GREAT OAKS BL (owner EQUINIX HYPERSCALE (2SV12) LLC) and the EQUINIX SV19 data center building permit at 131 GREAT OAKS BL on APN 70602060.
In the county FY2026 parcel layer situs 123 GREAT OAKS BL is parcel 706-02-057 and situs 127 GREAT OAKS BL is parcel 706-02-060; the two adjoin and form one 18.0-acre polygon.
unresolved: The permit records carry APN 706-02-054 for 123 Great Oaks Bl, which is absent from the FY2026 layer; the renumbering to 706-02-057 is inferred from the identical situs address and is not documented in a captured source.
The positions of the SV12 building and its data halls within the campus are not published; the point is a campus locator.
Parcel 706-02-058 (no situs) adjoins to the south-east; its use is unknown and it is excluded.
nearby_records: No Atlas site, project, source record, identity-mapping entry, pending fragment change, claim or hold coordinate lies within 2 km; the nearest Atlas site is the Microsoft Alviso San Jose Datacenter Campus, about 24.9 km north-west.
